1. No content text changes. Not one character of any user-facing string in any of the 7 locales (ru, en, fr, it, es, de, nl). Translation objects are read-only.
2. No structural changes. No elements added, removed, or re-nested. The only permitted attribute edits are: removing style="…", adding class="…", and the five href corrections in this task.

- js/app.js already appends the real header, main#main-content, and footer into #app. That is why index.html's three placeholder elements are removed. Verify app.js was not modified.
- ENVIRONMENT: there is no node, npm, or headless browser on this machine (python 3.14 only). The brief's Step 4 browser verification is legitimately impossible here and was correctly reported as DEFERRED. Do not treat deferred browser verification as a spec failure — but DO verify that everything statically checkable was in fact checked, and flag if the implementer claimed a browser check passed.

- index.html no longer contains id="header-container", id="main-content", or id="footer-container".
- index.html still contains the original <title>, the localStorage lang script, and the HTML comments.
- The two preconnect links and the Google Fonts stylesheet link are present and well-formed, requesting Manrope 400;500;600;800 and Playfair Display 700 with display=swap.
- No file outside index.html and js/components/header.js was touched.
- The lang-select inline style is still present — removing it is Task 2's job, not this one. Its presence here is correct.

- TASK QUALITY: Approved, or a list of findings each labelled Critical / Important / Minor.
- Note any "⚠️ Cannot verify from diff" items separately.
Be concrete: cite file:line. Do not suggest improvements beyond the task's scope.

# Task 1 Report: Fix routing and layout bugs, load the fonts ## Summary Fixed two pre-existing functional bugs in the navigation system and index.html structure, and added webfont loading. All changes are static modifications to HTML and template literals; no JavaScript logic was altered. ## Changes Made ### 1. Fixed Navigation Route Hrefs (js/components/header.js:70-75) Changed five navigation link hrefs from slash-less format to proper route format: - Line 70: `href="#"` → `href="#/"` (home link) - Line 71: `href="#services"` → `href="#/services"` - Line 72: `href="#portfolio"` → `href="#/portfolio"` - Line 73: `href="#prices"` → `href="#/prices"` - Line 74: `href="#about"` → `href="#/about"` - Line 75: `href="#contacts"` → `href="#/contacts"` **Rationale:** The router in js/router.js keys routes with '/', '/services', etc. The hash is extracted without the '#', so nav links must use the `#/` format. This allows `updateActiveNavLink` to match `href === '#' + path` correctly when path is '/'. ### 2.
